title: Billing Desk Ruling: Build-Stage Share of a Customer Remake Charge — Factory Production Orders
content:
**Ruling.** For Factory Production Orders, a build-stage share is applied to the charge for a customer specification remake by how far the order had been built when the remake was recorded, read from the checkpoints that cover every unit on the order (a checkpoint for remade or replacement units alone does not count): when the most recent such assembly complete checkpoint is dated on or before the remake date, the full charge is due; otherwise, when the most recent such glass received checkpoint is dated on or before the remake date, **70 percent** is due; otherwise **40 percent** is due.

The share multiplies the charge base itself, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Records read

The assembly complete and glass received checkpoints on the order's milestone records whose unit count is the full number of units on the factory order, each by its date, compared with the date of the remake recorded with cause customer specification error. A checkpoint covering only some of the units — such as one for remade or replacement units — is left out. A checkpoint dated on the remake date itself counts as on or before it.

## The three stages, in order

| Test, applied in this order | Share due |
|---|---|
| the most recent full-order assembly complete checkpoint is dated on or before the remake date | full charge |
| otherwise: the most recent full-order glass received checkpoint is dated on or before the remake date | 70 percent |
| otherwise | 40 percent |

Each order falls in exactly one stage: the first test that holds decides it, and an order meeting neither of the first two is charged 40 percent.

## Hypothetical cases (12-unit order, charge base of 500.00)

- A 12-unit assembly complete checkpoint dated 2 May, remake recorded 9 May: the full 500.00.
- No full-order assembly complete checkpoint; a 12-unit glass received checkpoint dated 9 May, remake recorded 9 May: 70 percent, 350.00.
- A 12-unit glass received checkpoint dated 15 May, after a remake recorded 9 May, and no full-order assembly checkpoint: 40 percent, 200.00.
- A 2-unit glass received checkpoint for replacement glass dated 5 May, remake recorded 9 May, and no full-order checkpoint of either kind: the 2-unit checkpoint does not count, so 40 percent, 200.00.
